verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer OTP app, but an authenticator product could plausibly publish an API, so the axis applies. The evidence covers app usage (sync, QR transfer, editing codes), the open-source HOTP/TOTP implementations and the PAM module. None of it mentions a public API or a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
